# MODULUX — Modular Homes Cape Town, South Africa

> MODULUX builds precision-engineered, NHBRC-registered modular homes in Cape Town and delivers nationwide across South Africa. Granny flats from R620,000. Display Village in Bellville, Western Cape.

## Company

- **Name:** MODULUX
- **Tagline:** The Modern Way of Housing
- **Website:** https://www.modulux.co.za
- **Email:** info@modulux.co.za
- **Phone:** +27 72 909 5837
- **Location:** 12 Modular Way, Bellville, Western Cape, 7530, South Africa
- **Service area:** Cape Town, Western Cape, and all nine provinces of South Africa

## What we do

MODULUX manufactures modular (prefab) homes in a Cape Town factory and delivers them fully finished to customer stands. We offer Standard, Premium, and Granny Flat designs from 10ft to 40ft double-wing folding units. All homes are NHBRC registered with a 15-year structural warranty.

## Frequently asked questions

**How long does delivery take?** Most MODULUX homes are completed in 60–90 days from order confirmation.

**Starting price?** Granny Flat designs from R620,000. See /designs for full pricing.

**Nationwide delivery?** Yes — all nine South African provinces.

**NHBRC registered?** Yes — all MODULUX homes are NHBRC registered.

**Financing?** Available through major South African banks; we can connect you with bond originators.

**Warranty?** 15-year structural, 1-year workmanship, plus manufacturer warranties on fittings.
